paper_title: Axion Dark Matter Search around 4.55 $μ$eV with Dine-Fischler-Srednicki-Zhitnitskii Sensitivity
notes: CAPP-12TB haloscope search excluding g_agamma down to ~6.2e-16 GeV^-1 (below DFSZ) over 4.51-4.59 ueV at 90% CL, assuming axions are 100% of local DM (rho_a = 0.45 GeV/cm^3), standard halo model with boosted Maxwellian lineshape. The full exclusion curve is in Fig. 4 (not tabulated), so the two points encode the representative flat limit quoted in text/abstract over the stated mass range. A small gap of 380 kHz around 4.527 ueV exists due to mode crossings.
